_pozn: TASK-179 (0.3.1), sada gate.ps1: destruktivni DB prikaz uvnitr kontejneroveho obalu (docker|podman exec|run, management podprikaz, compose, globalni volby; clenove tridy M-a az M-d z kroku 0). Format radku = task117 (name, group, tool, cmd, expect allow = MLCI | ask | deny, volitelne override). Verdikt 0.3.0 (cervena faze nad 245a0fe, 2026-10-18): kazdy radek s expect ask/deny mimo skupiny ctl-* a radky 'kontrola 0.3.0' byl allow (ticho); vsechny ostatni radky mely uz v 0.3.0 verdikt rovny expect. Skupiny: 17-24 tvary L2 TASK-179; run, mgmt, compose, glob, opt = AOPT-O27; Ma, Mb, Mc, Md = clenove z kroku 0 (2026-10-18-01-krok0.md); env = promenna prostredi vnitrniho prikazu; O26 = cil enginu a prepis gate.dbDestroyLocal; ctl-* = kontrolni skupiny par. 5 (verdikt beze zmeny).
